summary: The combined structural+mechanical compiled-dispatch validator exists and its bounded tests already prove the adapter behavior, but the live allocator owner does not expose an identified compiled-dispatch contract reference on claim-ready candidate data. Repository-scoped searches for compiled_dispatch_ref, mechanical_verifier_ref and compiled-dispatch-contract references returned no live consumer binding. build-claim-frontier is downstream of allocator eligibility and is therefore not a safe authority point. Blindly importing the validator into build-fast-allocator-core-v3 without the canonical contract-bearing input would either validate no real contract or create a parallel data path. No code mutation was made.
tests: PASS: existing combined validator and regression fixture are present.
PASS: claim-frontier was rejected as a downstream/non-authoritative binding point.
PASS: no duplicate validator, scheduler, contract store, or speculative data path was introduced.
BLOCKED: authoritative claim-ready consumer cannot consume a real compiled-dispatch contract until its canonical data binding/ref is durably identified.
unresolved: Identify or materialize, through the existing architecture owner, the canonical compiled-dispatch contract reference carried into allocator claim-ready eligibility; then bind the existing combined validator there.
